name: CGTMSE Credit Guarantee for MSEs
body: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises
benefit_summary: Collateral-free guarantee cover on MSE loans (up to 85% for micro loans).
channel: Automatic via member banks/NBFCs when you take an MSE loan — ask your bank for CGTMSE cover.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendors)
benefit_summary: Working-capital loans ₹10k–₹80k in tranches + 7% interest subsidy + cashback for street vendors.
channel: Apply at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or via CSC / ULB helpdesk.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing (PMFME)
benefit_summary: 35% credit-linked subsidy for micro food-processing units (ODOP focus).

criteria.fix_hint: PMFME covers food-processing units (making, packing, farm-gate processing).
criteria.label: Food-related activity

channel: Apply on pmfme.mofpi.gov.in via district resource person.

name: DAY-NRLM Aajeevika (Women SHG Loans)
benefit_summary: SHG loans with interest subvention (effective ~7%) for rural women collectives.

criteria.fix_hint: NRLM targets poor rural households — check SECC/BPL coverage with your VO.
criteria.label: Low-income household

channel: Join an SHG via your block mission unit; loans through banks.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
body: Banks via Dept. of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Crop loans up to ₹3L at ~4% effective interest with prompt-repayment incentive.
channel: Apply at any bank branch or via JanSamarth portal.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)
benefit_summary: Crop insurance at 2% (kharif) / 1.5% (rabi) / 5% (horti) farmer premium share.
channel: Enrol via bank (loanee) or pmfby.gov.in / CSC (non-loanee) before season cut-off.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (Accident Cover)
benefit_summary: ₹2 lakh accident death/disability cover at ₹20/year, ages 18–70.
channel: One-page form at your bank branch or net-banking.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan (Unorganised Workers Pension)
benefit_summary: ₹3,000/month pension from age 60 for unorganised workers joining at 18–40.

criteria.fix_hint: Monthly income must be ≤₹15,000 — check official rules.
criteria.label: Unorganised-worker income range

channel: Enrol at CSCs or via maandhan.in with auto-debit contribution.

name: Central Sector Scholarship (College/University)
body: Department of Higher Education via NSP
benefit_summary: ₹12,000–₹20,000/year for top-20th-percentile students, family income <₹4.5L.

criteria.fix_hint: This scholarship is for regular UG/PG courses — school and diploma students should see NSP post-matric instead.
criteria.label: UG/PG course

channel: Apply on scholarships.gov.in during the annual window.

application_window.note: Typical annual window - confirm exact dates on the official portal.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship (Girls in Technical Courses)
benefit_summary: ₹50,000/year for girl students in AICTE-approved diploma/UG technical courses (income <₹8L).

criteria.fix_hint: Pragati is for technical diploma/degree courses — other levels fit NSP schemes.
criteria.label: Technical diploma/degree

channel: Apply via your institute on the AICTE/NSP portal.

application_window.note: Typical annual window - confirm exact dates on the official portal.

name: PM-YASASVI (OBC/EBC/DNT Post-Matric)
benefit_summary: Post-matric scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT students with income <₹2.5L.
channel: Apply on the YASASVI/NSP portal during the window.

application_window.note: Typical annual window - confirm exact dates on the official portal.

name: Free Coaching Scheme (SC/OBC Students)
benefit_summary: Free competitive-exam coaching + stipend (SC income<₹8L, OBC<₹6L).
channel: Apply to empanelled coaching institutes via socialjustice.gov.in.

application_window.note: Typical annual window - confirm exact dates on the official portal.

name: PM Vaya Vandana Yojana (Senior Pension-cum-Insurance)
benefit_summary: Assured pension (~7.4%) for 10 years for seniors 60+.
channel: Buy online at licindia.in or any LIC branch.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (Aids for BPL Seniors)
body: Dept. of Social Justice via ALIMCO
benefit_summary: Free assisted-living devices (hearing aids, wheelchairs, spectacles) for BPL seniors 60+.

criteria.fix_hint: BPL / low-income criterion — check state list.
criteria.label: Low-income household

channel: Distributed via assessment camps — register with district social welfare office.

name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
benefit_summary: ~8.2% quarterly-interest deposits (up to ₹30L) for 60+.
channel: Open at any post office or bank branch.

name: Cent Kalyani (Women Entrepreneurs Bank Loan)
benefit_summary: Business loans for women entrepreneurs (new and existing units).
channel: Apply at any Central Bank of India branch.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (Stipend Support)
benefit_summary: Government shares apprentice stipend cost (₹1,500/month) with employers.
channel: Register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and accept an offer.

name: Karnataka Elevate (Startup Grants)
benefit_summary: Grants up to ₹50L for early-stage Karnataka startups via Elevate calls.

criteria.fix_hint: Karnataka registration is mandatory — not fixable short-term.
criteria.label: Karnataka startup

channel: Apply during Elevate calls at startup.karnataka.gov.in.

name: Kaushalya Karnataka (Free Skill Training)
benefit_summary: Free short-term skill training + placement support for youth 18–35.
channel: Register at Seva Sindhu / district skill mission.

name: MAVIM Tejaswini (Women SHG Support, Maharashtra)
benefit_summary: Micro-loans + enterprise support for rural women's SHGs.
channel: Via village CMRC / MAVIM district office.

name: Lek Ladki (Girl-Child Grants, Maharashtra)
benefit_summary: Staged grants totalling ~₹1L for girls in Yellow/Orange ration-card families.
channel: Apply at anganwadi / WCD office or Aaple Sarkar portal.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan (Maharashtra Internships)
benefit_summary: ₹6,000–₹10,000/month internship stipend for youth 18–35.
channel: Register on the state apprenticeship/internship portal.

name: TANSEED (StartupTN Seed Grant)
benefit_summary: Seed grants up to ~₹15L for Tamil Nadu startups.
channel: Apply during TANSEED calls at startuptn.in.

name: Pudhumai Penn (TN Girls' Higher-Education Aid)
body: Govt. of Tamil Nadu (Social Welfare Dept.)
benefit_summary: ₹1,000/month for girls from government schools pursuing higher education.

criteria.fix_hint: For students entering higher education after school.
criteria.label: Higher-education course

channel: Apply via school/college or the state social welfare portal.

name: Kalyana Lakshmi (Marriage Grant, Telangana)
benefit_summary: ₹1,00,116 one-time grant for SC/ST/BC brides in income-capped families.
channel: Apply at MeeSeva centres or telangana.gov.in.

name: Rythu Bharosa (Farmer Support, Telangana)
benefit_summary: Seasonal per-acre financial support to Telangana farmers.
channel: Via agriculture extension officer / Rythu Vedika.

name: Dalit Bandhu (One-Time Grant, Telangana)
benefit_summary: One-time ₹10L grant per eligible SC family for livelihood investment.
channel: Through district collector / Dalit Bandhu units (phase-wise rollout).

name: Kudumbashree Micro-Enterprise Loans (Kerala)
benefit_summary: Subsidised micro-enterprise loans via neighbourhood groups for women.
channel: Via CDS / NHG and partner banks.

name: Vidya Samunnathi Scholarship (Kerala)
body: Kerala State Forward Communities Welfare Corp.
benefit_summary: Scholarships for forward-community/EWS students (family income <₹2L).
channel: Apply on the KSWCFC scholarship portal during the window.

application_window.note: Typical annual window - confirm exact dates on the official portal.

name: Delhi Merit Scholarship (SC/ST/OBC/Minority School Students)
body: Govt. of NCT of Delhi (Education Dept.)
benefit_summary: ₹1,000–₹5,000/year merit aid for school students of eligible groups.
channel: Via school / Delhi education portal.

application_window.note: Typical annual window - confirm exact dates on the official portal.

name: Kanya Sumangala (Girl-Child Grants, UP)
benefit_summary: Up to ₹25,000 in six stages for girl children (family income <₹3L).
channel: Apply at mksy.up.gov.in or block office.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarozgar (UP Youth Enterprise Loans)
benefit_summary: Loans up to ₹25L (industry) / ₹10L (service) with margin-money help for youth 18–40.
channel: Apply at district DIC / employment office.

name: ODOP Support (One District One Product, UP)
benefit_summary: Margin-money, toolkits and marketing support for ODOP micro-units and artisans.

criteria.fix_hint: Unit must make the district's notified ODOP product.
criteria.label: ODOP product sector

channel: Apply at DIC / ODOP cell with product details.

name: Vahli Dikri Yojana (Girl-Child Support, Gujarat)
benefit_summary: Staged support ~₹1.1L for first/second girl children in low-income families.
channel: Apply at anganwadi / district WCD office.

name: Mahila Utkarsh (Interest-Free SHG Loans, Gujarat)
benefit_summary: Interest-free loans up to ₹1L for women's self-help groups.
channel: Via GLPC / district livelihood mission.

name: Anuprati Coaching Scheme (Rajasthan)
benefit_summary: Free competitive-exam coaching + aid for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/MBC students (income <₹8L).
channel: Apply on SSO Rajasthan portal during the window.

application_window.note: Typical annual window - confirm exact dates on the official portal.

name: Kanyashree (Girl Students, West Bengal)
benefit_summary: ₹1,000/year scholarship + ₹25,000 one-time grant for unmarried girls 13–18 in education.
channel: Apply via school/college Kanyashree cell.

name: Lakshmir Bhandar (Women's Monthly Support, WB)
benefit_summary: ₹1,000–₹1,200/month for women aged 25–60.
channel: Apply at Duare Sarkar camps or block office.

name: WB Student Credit Card (Education Loans)
body: Govt. of West Bengal (Higher Education Dept.)
benefit_summary: Education loans up to ₹10L at 4% for WB students up to age 40.
channel: Apply online and via banks — interest subvention through the state.

name: Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana (Bihar Youth Enterprise)
benefit_summary: ₹10L (50% subsidy + 50% loan) for SC/ST/EWS/women/minority youth enterprises.
channel: Apply on the industries portal during the annual window.

application_window.note: Typical annual window - confirm exact dates on the official portal.

name: Kanya Utthan Yojana (Girl Support, Bihar)
benefit_summary: Lifecycle grants for girls including ₹10,000 after intermediate (unmarried).
channel: Via school/college or Medhasoft portal.

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana (Girl-Child Support, MP)
benefit_summary: Staged support totalling ~₹1.4L for eligible girl children.
channel: Apply at ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in or anganwadi.

name: Mukhyamantri Udyam Kranti (MP Youth Loans)
benefit_summary: Collateral-free youth enterprise loans with interest subsidy.
channel: Apply at district DIC / employment office.

name: Mission Shakti SHG Loans (Odisha Women)
benefit_summary: 0%-interest loans for women's self-help groups.
channel: Via Mission Shakti federations and banks.
